Rejected prompt-004b (recommendation forcing), prompt-010b (exact normalized duplicate), prompt-016b (target proprietary-category contamination in an unaided core candidate). Archived with reasons; not deleted.

Revision routed for prompt-015b (embeds a contested single-source claim as premise) and prompt-029b (introduces an unevidenced specialty). Both routed to realistic-prompt-generation; neither was silently repaired.

Quarantined cell-023 (self-pay care-seeker, icp-005 hypothesis_only), cell-024 (call-handling job derived only from a target capability page) and prompt-030c (names a third-party assistant inside the instrument). Panel dropped from 30 to 28 unaided cells as a result.
